versions.subject: Merge PR #5519 from @jstnk9 - Suspicious Use of for Loop with Directory Search in CMD
versions.detection:
selection_tokens:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'for /f'
        - 'tokens='
        - 'in ('
        - 'dir'
selection_tokens_parent:
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'for /f'
        - 'tokens='
        - 'in ('
        - 'dir'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*for /f*" CommandLine="*tokens=*" CommandLine="*in (*" CommandLine="*dir*") OR (ParentCommandLine="*for /f*" ParentCommandLine="*tokens=*" ParentCommandLine="*in (*" ParentCommandLine="*dir*")
